verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a product that exposes a developer API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or demo instance; the API docs say there is no vendor-hosted or public demo instance and that keys are live credentials. Spinning up a separate self-hosted instance would be a user-side workaround, tenant isolation is an adjacent feature, and the Linux chrome-sandbox file is an unrelated packaging detail, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
